purpose.summary: Bind the public mainnet reproduction driver to the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0018 direct-public-prefix target and its v2 report contract.

Validate only the v2 independent-public-prefix report: both roles use public mainnet, both acquire and restart independently, and their immutable checkpoint-288 observations match.
Preserve the existing source, signature, build, dependency, privacy, cleanup and fail-closed reproduction boundaries.
Use the unchanged existing workflow, which already self-tests this driver on governed changes and reserves network execution for explicit workflow dispatch.

No dispatch, incoming artifact, evidence promotion or claim that the direct-public profile has run on a public reproducer.
No legacy loopback-bridge report field, candidate-from-baseline transfer claim or v1 smoke report is accepted for this target.
No current-tip, full-history, simultaneous-operation, peer-diversity, sustained-operation, deterministic-build, operator-binary or mainnet-coexistence claim.
No raw child output, peer address, absolute host path, parent environment, cookie, secret, port, datadir or runtime artifact enters generated evidence.
